Onboarding.title: A few minutes to activate your receptionist.
Onboarding.subtitle: Connect your Google Calendar (optional), then we'll assign you a dedicated Twilio number — all included in the free trial.
Onboarding.step1DescDisabled: Connecting YOUR Google Calendar/Sheets is reserved for Global and Premium plans. On WhatsApp plan, your agent uses a shared calendar and sends confirmations via WhatsApp.
Onboarding.step1DescAvailable: So your agent can book appointments in YOUR calendar and save contacts to YOUR sheet. You can also do this later from the dashboard.
Onboarding.redirectHintTitle: Prerequisite: add the redirect URI in Google Cloud Console
Onboarding.redirectHintStep1Post: → APIs & Services → Credentials → your OAuth client.
Onboarding.redirectHintFooter: Without this, Google refuses OAuth with redirect_uri_mismatch.
Onboarding.googleStatusDenied: Connection denied — retry or continue without for now.
Onboarding.googleStatusNoRefresh: Google didn't return a refresh token. Go to https://myaccount.google.com/permissions, remove app access, and reconnect.
Onboarding.googleStatusUserMismatch: Google account differs from the connected tenant.
Onboarding.step2Title: Which language should your agent use to greet calls?
Onboarding.step2Desc: This language will be used for the opening line. The agent automatically switches to the caller's language once they speak.
Onboarding.skipNote: You can change it later from the dashboard.
Onboarding.errNoNumbers: No numbers available for this country right now. Try again in a few minutes or pick another country.
Onboarding.doneDesc: Connected to your receptionist. Call it to test.

Dashboard.googleNotConnected: Google Calendar not connected. Without it, your agent can't book appointments in YOUR calendar.
Dashboard.whatsappPlanDesc: Connecting your own Google Calendar/Sheets is locked.
Dashboard.trialExpired: Your trial is over. Your account will be deleted shortly.

DashboardConfig.pageSubtitle: Edit the persona, tone, and technical parameters of the agent. Changes take effect on the next call — the agent reloads configuration at the start of every session.
DashboardConfig.personaSubtitle: The big system string that defines identity, style, and workflows.
DashboardConfig.primaryLanguageHint: Language used for the opening line. The agent automatically switches to the caller's language once they speak.
DashboardConfig.instructionsHint: Markdown supported. Describe the agent's name + business name, hours, services, tone, and the workflows to follow.
DashboardConfig.greetingHint: The first sentence spoken on every call — before the caller speaks. Keep it short and warm (1-2 sentences). E.g., "Hello, this is Johana from Prestige Salon, how can I help you?"
DashboardConfig.greetingPlaceholder: Hello, this is <name> from <business>. How can I help you?
DashboardConfig.whatsappSubtitle: After every call, a summary is sent via WhatsApp to the caller and the owner.
DashboardConfig.ownerWhatsappHint: International format, e.g., +972585001007. Leave blank to disable.
DashboardConfig.whatsappFooter: The caller also receives a summary if Twilio detects she accepts WhatsApp messages from her call number. Configure TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM on Railway to enable sending.
DashboardConfig.voiceSubtitleAdmin: Technical parameters of the voice engine. Admin-only.
DashboardConfig.voiceSubtitleUser: Pick your agent's voice and speech speed.
